strings.ui.title: NEON CHRONICLE
strings.ui.reset_confirm: Delete your save and start over?
strings.ui.rebirth_summary: You lived {age} as a {job} and earned {earned} credits. As your body fell, the sync sent part of this life's memories back to your mind copy.
strings.ui.upgrades_note: Memories that survived the sync tune your next awakening.
strings.ui.awaken: Wake up in a new body
strings.log.awaken: Life {life}: you wake up in a new body at the back-alley clinic. Pick a job.
strings.log.awaken_first: Life {life}: you wake up at the back-alley clinic. Mio, the street doctor, says, "If you need work, Jin will set you up." Pick a job.
strings.log.job: Jin, the fixer, set you up with work as a {job}.
strings.log.death: Your body broke down. Memory points +{points}
strings.job.courier.name: Courier
strings.job.courier.desc: Run packages through the back alleys. Safe but poorly paid. Negotiation raises pay.
strings.job.hacker.name: Hacker
strings.job.hacker.desc: Dive into corporate networks and sell stolen data. Hacking raises pay.
strings.job.mercenary.name: Mercenary
strings.job.mercenary.desc: Take on corporate dirty work with a gun. Big pay, but your body wears out fast.
strings.skill.hacking.name: Hacking
strings.skill.combat.name: Combat
strings.skill.combat.desc: Raises Mercenary pay and slightly slows body decay.
strings.skill.negotiation.name: Negotiation
strings.skill.negotiation.desc: Raises Courier pay and slightly raises all income.
strings.implant.neural_chip.name: Neural accelerator
strings.implant.bone_frame.name: Reinforced skeleton
strings.implant.credit_spoofer.name: Credit score spoofer
strings.implant.credit_spoofer.desc: Income +50%. Installed in your net identity, not your body, so it stays after rebirth.
strings.upgrade.echo.name: Echoes of memory
strings.upgrade.contacts.name: Black market contacts
strings.upgrade.frame.name: Sturdy chassis
strings.upgrade.talent.name: Inherited talent
strings.event.odd_package.name: Odd Package
strings.event.odd_package.desc: Something inside the package is humming. The client only said: don't look inside.
strings.event.odd_package.fall: collapsed while delivering a suspicious package
strings.event.odd_package.deliver.name: Deliver it as is
strings.event.odd_package.deliver.result: You delivered the package. The man who took it was trembling a little.
strings.event.odd_package.inspect.name: Check it and raise the price
strings.event.odd_package.inspect.result: It was a corporate prototype. You got a bigger fee for keeping quiet.
strings.event.odd_package.dump.name: Dump it in an alley
strings.event.odd_package.dump.result: You dumped the package and ran. You had to pay back the advance.
strings.event.gang_toll.name: Alley Toll
strings.event.gang_toll.desc: A gang blocks the shortcut through the alley. They want a toll.
strings.event.gang_toll.fall: went down under a beating from alley thugs
strings.event.gang_toll.pay.name: Pay
strings.event.gang_toll.pay.result: You paid the toll and got through.
strings.event.gang_toll.talk.name: Talk your way through
strings.event.gang_toll.talk.result: You dropped the right name, and the gang stepped aside.
strings.event.gang_toll.run.name: Run for it
strings.event.gang_toll.run.result: You took a few hits, but made it through.
strings.event.corp_trace.name: Corporate Trace
strings.event.corp_trace.desc: Corporate security has started tracing your connection. They will find you soon.
strings.event.corp_trace.fall: fell when a corporate counterattack burned the nerves
strings.event.corp_trace.cut.name: Cut the connection
strings.event.corp_trace.cut.result: You cut the connection and lost the data you were stealing.
strings.event.corp_trace.push.name: Grab the data anyway
strings.event.corp_trace.push.result: You got the data, but the counterattack burned your nerves.
strings.event.corp_trace.counter.name: Trace them back
strings.event.corp_trace.counter.result: You followed the trace back and opened another corporate vault.
strings.event.rival_hacker.name: Rival Hacker
strings.event.rival_hacker.desc: An unknown hacker challenges you: who can break the firewall first?
strings.event.rival_hacker.decline.name: Ignore it
strings.event.rival_hacker.decline.result: You ignored the challenge and kept working.
strings.event.rival_hacker.accept.name: Accept
strings.event.rival_hacker.accept.result: You won. The rival shared a few tricks before leaving.
strings.event.betrayal.name: Betrayal
strings.event.betrayal.desc: On the way back from a job, your partner points a gun at you to keep the whole payment.
strings.event.betrayal.fall: was shot down by a traitor
strings.event.betrayal.fight.name: Shoot it out
strings.event.betrayal.fight.result: You won the shootout and kept the payment. The bullets left their marks.
strings.event.betrayal.give_up.name: Hand over the payment
strings.event.betrayal.give_up.result: You handed over the payment and walked away.
strings.event.betrayal.talk.name: Talk them down
strings.event.betrayal.talk.result: You told them what the client was really after. They lowered the gun.
strings.event.ambush.name: Ambush
strings.event.ambush.desc: Corporate soldiers are waiting in ambush just before the target.
strings.event.ambush.retreat.name: Fall back
strings.event.ambush.charge.name: Break through
strings.event.ambush.charge.result: You broke through and took their gear as well.
strings.chronicle.no_job: Lived without ever taking a job
strings.chronicle.end_decay: fell when the body gave out
strings.job.hacker.chronicle: Lived as a hacker diving into corporate networks
strings.job.mercenary.chronicle: Lived as a mercenary doing corporate dirty work
strings.event.odd_package.inspect.chronicle: found a corporate prototype in a package and raised the fee
strings.event.odd_package.dump.chronicle: dumped a suspicious package and ran
strings.event.gang_toll.pay.chronicle: paid a gang's toll in an alley
strings.event.gang_toll.talk.chronicle: talked past an alley gang with the right name
strings.event.gang_toll.run.chronicle: ran through an alley gang taking a few hits
strings.event.corp_trace.cut.chronicle: cut the connection when a corporation traced it
strings.event.corp_trace.push.chronicle: stole corporate data through a nerve-burning counterattack
strings.event.corp_trace.counter.chronicle: followed a corporate trace back and opened another vault
strings.event.rival_hacker.accept.chronicle: beat a rival hacker to the firewall
strings.event.betrayal.fight.chronicle: shot it out with a traitor and kept the pay
strings.event.betrayal.give_up.chronicle: handed the pay to a traitor and walked away
strings.event.betrayal.talk.chronicle: talked down a comrade who drew a gun
strings.event.ambush.charge.chronicle: broke straight through a corporate ambush
strings.ui.fragment_next: Next fragment: end a life with {requires}
strings.ui.fragments_all: All memories have returned. You can breach the core server.
strings.log.ending: You reached the end of the story. Memory points +{points}
strings.fragment.white_room.name: The White Room
strings.fragment.white_room.desc: A memory of waking in a white operating room. Faceless technicians were saying, "Transferring the subject's consciousness." One of them whispered, "I'm sorry." It was the voice of Mio, who greets you at the clinic every life. You still can't remember your own name.
strings.fragment.contract.name: The Contract
strings.fragment.contract.desc: A memory of signing a contract with a shaking hand. Your debts would be erased in exchange for giving your body to corporate research. The other party was the research division of the corporation that rules Neon City.
strings.fragment.name.name: Your Name
strings.fragment.name.desc: An old friend is calling your name. It is Jin, the fixer who finds you work every life. Jin doesn't recognize you in your new body. You were once a skilled hacker who broke through corporate firewalls. The corporation wanted those skills, so it extracted only your mind.
strings.fragment.project.name: The Project
strings.fragment.project.desc: A memory of a project file you glimpsed. Under the name of the Iteration Project, the corporation put extracted minds into disposable bodies and used them for dirty work. When a body fell, the mind copy was loaded into a new one. Your many lives were part of that project. But you alone wake up at Mio's clinic, not in a corporate facility.
strings.fragment.core.name: The Core Server
strings.fragment.core.desc: You remember where your real body is. It lies asleep, preserved deep inside the corporation's core server. If you can breach it, you can take your body back.
strings.ending.reclaim.name: Your Real Body
strings.ending.reclaim.desc: After a long sleep, you open your eyes in your real body. It is heavy and slow to obey. Still, nothing wears it down anymore. You leaked every record of what the corporation did to you onto the city's net. Morning in Neon City is brighter than you expected.
strings.ending.remain.name: Ghost in the Net
strings.ending.remain.desc: You chose not to return to your body and stayed in the corporation's core. Now the corporation's whole net is your body. One by one, you free the minds trapped in disposable bodies. Now and then, the lights of Neon City flicker like a signal.
strings.ending.remain.chronicle: left the body behind and stayed in the corporate net
strings.job.core_breach.name: Core Infiltrator
strings.job.core_breach.desc: Dive into the corporation's core server to find your real body. Pays well, but the defense systems burn through your body fast. Unlocked when all memory fragments have returned.
strings.event.core_server.name: The Core Gate
strings.event.core_server.desc: Past the last layer of the firewall, you see your own body, still asleep. The corporation's whole net is within reach too. Returning to your body means giving this power up.
strings.event.core_server.reclaim.name: Return to your real body
strings.event.core_server.reclaim.result: You poured your mind into your real body.
strings.event.core_server.remain.name: Stay in the core as data
strings.event.core_server.remain.result: You left your body behind and stayed in the corporate net.
strings.mio.decay.1: Mio: "Welcome back. You used that body to its limit. Your next one is ready."
strings.mio.decay.2: Mio: "Another body used up. Let's tune your next awakening."
strings.mio.decay.3: Mio: "Every time I bring you back, you're still you. Use this body to the end, too."
strings.mio.event.1: Mio: "You {fall}? Bodies can be replaced. Memories don't all come back."
strings.mio.event.2: Mio: "So you {fall}. Don't fall the same way in this body."
strings.mio.event.3: Mio: "You {fall} again? And still, you always come back here."
